parts.text: F: CH. ZOTTELS HAPPILY EVER AFTER

parts: We are planning a very special litter on 2011. We'll mated our London, imported from England with our female Thalia imported from Argentina and daughter of Ch. Sincerely Your Zottels to unite some important European blood-lines (Zottels, Reata's, LamedaZottel...) with some important American blood-lines (Lambluv, To-Jo).
Page will be updated with photos and news.
Include also the following information to your e-mail:
- short presentation about yourself and your family;
- your experience in Bobtail (or other breed) and your possible prefix.
We do try to answer all inquiries. Sometimes it may take a few days for a reply.
Also you can also consult by phone +00 34 676 22 08 96.
